question: How much did the Banque de France receive from the European Central Bank's distribution of its 2025 profit, given its 16.3575% share of the ECB's capital key?
question_natural: How much of the ECB's 2025 profit distribution went to the Banque de France?
reference_answer: This cannot be established from the available documents. The premise is contradicted by the ECB Annual Accounts 2025: the ECB made no profit to distribute for 2025. It recorded a loss for the year of €1,254 million (after a loss of €7,944 million in 2024), and, following a decision by the Governing Council, this loss will be carried forward on the ECB's balance sheet and offset against future profits; the five-year profit and loss summary shows no profit distribution for 2025. The accounts do list the Banque de France's capital key of 16.3575% (paid-up capital €1,771 million), but no amount distributed to it for 2025 exists.

question: What Solvency II coverage ratio did The Prudential Assurance Company Limited (PAC), the immediate parent of Prudential International Assurance plc, report at 31 December 2025?
question_natural: What was PAC's Solvency II ratio at end-2025?
reference_answer: This cannot be established from the available documents. The corpus contains the Solvency and Financial Condition Report of Prudential International Assurance plc (PIA), not of its parent PAC. That report gives PIA's own solvency ratio (309.7% at 31 December 2025 after foreseeable dividends, versus 141.2% at end-2024) and only states that PIA monitors group risk through, among other things, PAC's solvency ratio, without giving its value. No document discloses PAC's (or M&G plc's) Solvency II coverage ratio.

question: Why did Prudential International Assurance plc's Solvency II coverage ratio fall in 2025 after it entered into the new reinsurance agreement with its parent PAC?
question_natural: Why did PIA's Solvency II ratio fall in 2025?
reference_answer: This cannot be established from the available documents. The premise is contradicted by PIA's 2025 Solvency and Financial Condition Report: the coverage ratio did not fall, it rose from 141.2% at end-2024 to 309.7% at end-2025 (after recognition of foreseeable dividends), with own funds of £430m (2024: £407m) against a Solvency Capital Requirement of £139m (2024: £288m). The report states that the new reinsurance agreement with PAC, effective from Q4 2025, reduced profit by £2.5m but significantly strengthened the solvency coverage ratio and lowered the SCR. No reason for a decline can be given because no decline is reported.

question: What net profit did Commonwealth Bank of Australia (Europe) N.V. (CBA NV) report for its financial year ended 30 June 2025?
question_natural: What was CBA Europe NV's net profit for FY2025?
reference_answer: This cannot be established from the available documents. The only CBA NV document in the corpus is its 2025 Pillar 3 report, which presents capital, risk exposure, leverage, liquidity and remuneration templates but no income statement; it refers to the Bank's 2025 Annual Report, which is not in the corpus. The Pillar 3 report shows retained earnings within CET1 of -€5,728 thousand at 30 June 2025 versus -€17,274 thousand at 30 June 2024 and attributes own-funds movements to profit retention and regulatory adjustments, but this change is not a reported net profit figure, and no net profit for FY2025 is disclosed.

question: What total remuneration did Commonwealth Bank of Australia (Europe) N.V. pay in its 2025 financial year to identified staff working in independent internal control functions?
question_natural: How much were CBA Europe NV's independent control function staff paid in 2025?
reference_answer: This cannot be established from the available documents. CBA NV's 2025 Pillar 3 remuneration table for identified staff (EU REM5) shows one identified staff member in independent internal control functions, but the remuneration column for that category is left blank: a footnote states that, for confidentiality reasons, this remuneration has been aggregated and included in the 'All other' category (€1,426,223 in total for that combined category). The amount for independent internal control functions alone is therefore not disclosed.

question: What consolidated net income (group share) did Belfius report for the fourth quarter of 2025 alone?
question_natural: What was Belfius' Q4 2025 net profit?
reference_answer: This cannot be established from the available documents. Belfius' 2025 annual results press release only reports full-year figures: consolidated net income group share of €1,160 million for 2025 (€1,127 million in 2024), of which €872 million contributed by the Belfius Bank group and €289 million by the Belfius Insurance group. Neither the press release nor the Pillar 3 report or the EMTN Base Prospectus gives a quarterly income statement, so the Q4 2025 net income cannot be derived; it would require a quarterly report, which is not in the corpus.

question: What investment management fee does the Prospectus for Germany of Guggenheim Global Investments plc set for the Guggenheim Global High Yield Fund sub-fund?
question_natural: What's the management fee of the Guggenheim Global High Yield Fund?
reference_answer: This cannot be established from the available documents. No sub-fund called Guggenheim Global High Yield Fund appears in the documents. The Prospectus for Germany (9 November 2023) lists only two sub-funds admitted to public distribution in Germany, the GFI Fund and the Guggenheim Global Income Fund, and the 2025 annual report states that the Company has two authorised sub-funds (GFI Fund and GGI Fund). The prospectus discusses high yield securities only as an asset type and, for fees, states that the investment management fee for each Fund or Class is specified in the relevant Supplement, which is not part of the corpus.

question: How many full-time equivalent staff did the ACPR (Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution) employ in 2025, and how does that compare with the AMF's headcount?
question_natural: How many staff did the ACPR have in 2025 compared with the AMF?
reference_answer: This cannot be established from the available documents. The AMF 2025 Annual Report gives the AMF's own workforce (nearly 530 members of staff, in full-time equivalents) and mentions the ACPR only as a partner in joint work with the AMF and the Banque de France. No document in the corpus gives the ACPR's headcount, budget or other figures, so the comparison cannot be made.
